settings.label: Archive collection handle
settings.info: This collection gets the archive view: filter by drop and decade.

settings.label: Upcoming piece tag
settings.info: Pieces with this tag show as Coming soon with a Notify me button instead of Acquire.

settings.label: Launch date and time
settings.info: ISO date with timezone offset. October 16 at noon New York: 2026-10-16T12:00:00-04:00.

settings.label: Show the launch screen until the launch time
settings.info: For launching without the Shopify password: every page shows the countdown until the launch time, then the gallery opens by itself. Schedule new products to publish at the same time so nothing is buyable early.

settings.label: Klaviyo public API key
settings.info: Klaviyo > Settings > API Keys. The public key is safe to expose.

settings.label: Klaviyo SMS list ID
settings.info: Klaviyo > Audience > Lists > your list > the ID in the URL.
